name: @smlight/zerostack-adapter
description: SMLIGHT ZeroStack zigbee-herdsman adapter: a native ZeroStack coordinator addon for zigbee-herdsman
author: SMLIGHT

scripts.prepack: node -e "if (process.env.ZS_ALLOW_PARTIAL_PACK === '1') process.exit(0); const fs = require('node:fs'); const tags = ['linux-x64-gnu', 'linux-arm64-gnu', 'linux-x64-musl', 'linux-arm64-musl', 'linux-arm-gnueabihf', 'linux-arm-musleabihf', 'linux-riscv64-gnu', 'darwin-arm64', 'darwin-x64', 'win32-x64-msvc', 'win32-arm64-msvc']; const missing = tags.filter((t) => !fs.existsSync('zerostack_adapter.' + t + '.node')); if (missing.length) { console.error('Missing prebuilt addons: ' + missing.map((t) => 'zerostack_adapter.' + t + '.node').join(', ') + ' (set ZS_ALLOW_PARTIAL_PACK=1 for local dry-runs)'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.build: npm run build:addon && npm run build:ts
scripts.build:ts: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', {recursive: true, force: true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test: npm run test:rust && npm run test:unit && npm run test:node
